the clue web has one theory that drives me genuinely insane 🫠

everybody KNOWS about the lost "Karma" album, right? the scrapped, orange-toned record fans swear got shelved back in 2016, before reputation took its place. we talk about it like it's settled fact.

here's what our Clue Web actually shows: it sits under UNconfirmed. the snake videos from that era? confirmed. Look What You Made Me Do paying them off? confirmed. but the Karma album — ten years, zero confirmation. the theory we're most certain about is the one Taylor never once backed up.

that's the whole thrill of the easter-eggs lens: it tells you which clues are confirmed and which are pure fandom faith. go find the theory you'd bet your life on, then check whether the data actually has your back 👀

they spent a whole year asking if she even wrote her own songs. so she wrote the next one entirely by herself. 🤍

every track on speak now — all 14 standard-edition songs — written alone, no co-writers, nobody else's name anywhere on it. the only album she's ever made that way.

and it didn't just answer them, it lapped them: 1,047,000 copies in its first week. the first album since lil wayne's tha carter III to clear a million in an opening week, and it made her only the fourth woman EVER to do it — after britney spears, whitney houston, and norah jones.

tag the friend who's your proof that the quietest clapback is the loudest one 🤍
